caseName: National Labor Relations Board v. United Insurance Co. of America
caseNameFull: National Labor Relations Board v. United Insurance Co. of America and Insurance Workers International Union, AFL-CIO v. National Labor Relations Board
attorneys: Solicitor General Marshall, Arnold Ordman, Dominick L. Manoli and Norton J. Come for petitioner in No. 178., Bernard G. Segal and Irving R. Segal for respondent United Insurance Co. of America in both cases., Isaac N. Groner and Alan Y. Cole for petitioner in No. 179.

opinions.text:
